full_judgment: 8. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate on Record for the petitioner submits that the High Court Division was in error in interfering with the order of the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate rejecting the petition of complaint since during enquiry held by the Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate no reliable evidence was produced by the complainant and consequent thereupon allegation made in the petition of complaint was not established. The learned Advocate-on-Record also submits the Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate was quite correct in recommending for dismissal of the petition of complaint since there were no reliable material to proceed against the petitioner and thus in the light of the recommendation so made by the Magistrate who held enquiry into the allegation the petition of complaint was quite correctly rejected by the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate and by such rejection no illegality was committed.
